import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["invoices"].copy()

    amount = pd.to_numeric(df["amount"], errors="coerce")
    tax = pd.to_numeric(df["tax"], errors="coerce")
    due_date = df["due_date"]
    customer_ref = df["customer_ref"]

    amount_null = amount.isna()
    tax_null = tax.isna()

    r1 = amount_null | (amount < 0)
    r2 = tax_null | (tax < 0)

    both_present = ~amount_null & ~tax_null
    r3 = pd.Series(False, index=df.index)
    r3.loc[both_present] = tax[both_present] > (amount[both_present] * 0.5)

    r4 = due_date.isna()

    ref_is_null = customer_ref.isna()
    ref_trimmed_empty = customer_ref.apply(
        lambda x: isinstance(x, str) and x.strip() == ""
    )
    r5 = ref_is_null | ref_trimmed_empty

    rules = [
        (r1, "AMT_BAD"),
        (r2, "TAX_BAD"),
        (r3, "TAX_EXCESS"),
        (r4, "DUE_NULL"),
        (r5, "REF_EMPTY"),
    ]

    def build_reason_codes(idx):
        codes = []
        for mask, code in rules:
            if mask.loc[idx]:
                codes.append(code)
        return "|".join(codes)

    reason_codes = pd.Series(
        [build_reason_codes(idx) for idx in df.index], index=df.index
    )

    has_failure = reason_codes.str.len() > 0

    invoices_clean = df.loc[~has_failure].copy()

    invoices_rejects = df.loc[has_failure].copy()
    invoices_rejects["reason_codes"] = reason_codes.loc[has_failure]

    return {
        "invoices_clean": invoices_clean.reset_index(drop=True),
        "invoices_rejects": invoices_rejects.reset_index(drop=True),
    }
